protocol.cachePolicy: same process, balanced mode order, caches retained and recorded
protocol.costPolicy: Opt-in synthetic billing observation lets started requests finish under a separate 5s limit without delaying fallback. SDK generation estimates and response-reported classifier costs are separate; aggregate key delta is not an isolated per-mode invoice. Await terminal billing outside reply timing; unknown costs stop dispatch.
protocol.providerPolicy: Unchanged School Cerebras preference, fallbacks enabled, Groq excluded. 20B has no listed Cerebras host; this compares operational configurations, not identical-host model speed.
protocol.comparisonPolicy: Current parallel Jev policy, not Jev-first. Shared routing caches retained; rotated model/mode order. Capture actual model/provider/usage.cost through benchmark-only response observer; SDK prices remain estimates.
